Write 3 professional auto-responder messages for different situations:
1. Out of office (vacation): I'm away from [start date] to [end date]. Include who to contact urgently ([name, email]), when I'll respond to non-urgent emails, and a touch of personality (not just the default corporate template).
2. New inquiry auto-response: Someone just filled out my contact form or emailed me for the first time. Confirm I received it, set expectations on response time ([X hours/days]), and point them to [a FAQ page / booking link / resource] while they wait.
3. Support ticket acknowledgment: A customer just submitted a support request. Confirm receipt, give them a ticket number placeholder, set expectations for resolution time, and link to [self-serve resources / knowledge base] in case they can solve it faster themselves.
Each under 80 words. Tone: human, not robotic.

Here's a data set / raw numbers I need analyzed:
[Paste your data — could be survey results, website analytics, sales numbers, customer feedback scores, financial data, etc.]
Please: (1) Summarize the key findings in 3-5 bullet points a non-technical person would understand, (2) Identify the most important trends — what's going up, what's going down, and what's staying flat, (3) Flag any anomalies or surprising data points, (4) Give me 3 specific recommendations based on this data (not generic — based on what the numbers actually show), (5) Suggest what I should track or investigate next. Present this as a one-page executive summary I could send to a business partner.
